error.message: The image format is not supported.
error.error_user_msg: The image could not be processed because its format could not be recognized. This usually means the file is corrupted, not a valid image, or the URL returned an error page instead of an image. Please verify that the image_url points to a valid image file in a supported format (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, HEIC, or AVIF). For more information on supported formats and media specifications, see: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-graph-api/reference/ig-user/media#creating
